---
title: Get Started with orthoDr
---

orthoDr estimates a small set of directions in a feature matrix for regression,
right censored survival outcomes, and personalized dose finding. It also provides
a general optimizer for objectives with orthogonality constraints.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(rprojroot::find_package_root_file("tools", "pkgdown-guide.R"), local = TRUE)
```

## Install and check your version

```{r installation, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(guide_section("Version and installation"), sep = "\n")
```

## Choose a workflow

| Your task | Start with | Tutorial |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Reduce predictors of a continuous outcome | `orthoDr_reg()` | [Regression](regression.html) |
| Reduce predictors of a censored survival outcome | `orthoDr_surv()` | [Survival](survival.html) |
| Learn a dose rule from features, doses, and rewards | `orthoDr_pdose()` | [Personalized dose finding](personalized-dose.html) |
| Optimize your own objective under $B^T B = I$ | `ortho_optim()` | [General optimizer](general-optimizer.html) |

The model tutorials show how to fit and predict. Set `keep.data = TRUE` when
fitting a model you will use for prediction. Inspect the returned `converge`
flag before interpreting a fitted result. A direction's sign is arbitrary;
compare fitted subspaces or predictions when assessing two fits.

## Download and reproduce the examples

- [Complete getting-started R script](../examples/getting-started.R)
- [Full survival and optimizer R script](../examples/survival-optimizer.R),
  including the SKCM data and 2D and 3D plots
- [Function reference](../reference/index.html) and [changelog](../news/index.html)

The four tutorials reuse the output of the complete getting-started script.
That script and the full survival example run during `R CMD check` through
`tests/examples.R`. Site builds regenerate the guide from the installed source
package. For help matching your own installed version, use
`help(package = "orthoDr")`.
